title: This Torpedo Travels Underwater at 230 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: This torpedo travels underwater at 230 miles an hour.
It's the Russian Shkval, and it doesn't really swim.
A rocket pushes it, and its nose blows gas around the body.
It rides inside a giant bubble, so almost no water touches it.
With so little drag, it reaches about 200 knots.

description:
This torpedo travels underwater at 230 miles an hour.
The Russian Shkval wraps itself in a bubble of gas called supercavitation, which cuts drag dramatically and lets it reach about 200 knots.
Could you even imagine moving that fast underwater?
first_comment: Bonus: it was launched at about 50 knots, then a rocket took over. What else should be this fast?
